newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ABN AMRO ADSs priced at $18.50.
newsitem.headline: ABN AMRO ADSs priced at $18.50.

text.p: Dutch bank ABN AMRO NV said on Wednesday the price of 14 million shares offered for resale in connection with its New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) listing today was set at $18.50.
ABN AMRO, the largest foreign bank in the United States, said this was based on the closing price of its shares on the Amsterdam Stock Exchange on Tuesday.
The shares, in the form of American Depositary Shares (ADSs), will begin trading under the symbol "AAN" at 1330 GMT, with each ADS representing one ABN AMRO ordinary share.

"It is intended that the NYSE listing will further raise ABN AMRO's efforts to broaden its international shareholder base by providing U.S. investors and employees with a more visible and dollar-denominated security," ABN AMRO said.
